experiment: E -- the official score, its exact decomposition, and why the levers still cannot compile
question: D and D2 measured Toffoli counts and hand-checked correctness. What score does the competition's own verifier assign, where in the reference's gate stream does that saving come from, and can a pinned primitive read a qubit into a bit?

verifier_patch.with: 'reaction_depth': None,  # not computed by Experiment E
verifier_patch.why: `reaction_depth` is a reported diagnostic, not part of the score; on the 86M-op reference it peaked at 13.9 GB and took 136 s, which gets the process killed here. Every scoring line is the shipped one.

checks.check: the reference reproduces the row D2 recorded
checks.requirement: 5725071.609375 Toffolis per shot at Q=1893 (within 0.0001 relative: the executed mean is shot-dependent)

checks.check: the candidate reproduces the row D2 recorded
the competition's verifier passes both circuits
checks.requirement: status PASS, zero value and phase errors, and eps_plus < 1/16 at 102400 shots

checks.check: the score ratio is the Toffoli ratio, exactly
checks.requirement: no R and no Q penalty: score_ratio == T_ratio to 1e-12

checks.check: the saving is exactly the multiply's 9 Toffolis per call
checks.requirement: static delta 291672 == 9 x 32,408 calls = 291,672, and the executed delta within 1% of it

checks.check: no pinned primitive reads a qubit's value into a bit
checks.requirement: every qubit->bit writer in the pinned surface writes something that is not the qubit's value

finding: under the competition's own `verify()` at 102,400 shots the reference passes with 0 value and 0 phase errors and scores 2.443946e+13 (Q=1893, T=5725108.382109); the phase-safe 54-AND candidate passes with 0 and 0 and scores 2.319438e+13, a ratio of 0.949054. That is exactly its Toffoli ratio (0.949054) at equal Q, because both runs share the same zero-error `eps_plus` and therefore the same `R` -- the comparison carries no error-rate or qubit penalty in either direction. The saving is the multiply's alone: 32,408 calls x 9 = 291,672 static Toffolis per shot, exactly the measured static delta (291672); executed, the two circuits differ by 291670.152 per shot, the rest being the classically conditioned Toffolis whose firing is shot-dependent. The multiply is 42.45% of the reference's static Toffoli stream and the candidate removes 5.0943% of it (5.0946% of the executed mean). The levers' obstacle is measured here rather than assumed: of 29 pinned methods whose signature mentions a classical bit, 1 writes a bit from qubit data (hmr), and on |1> `hmr` wrote the value on 24/64 shots, so nothing in the pinned binary can express a read.

scope.measured: the competition's verifier on both circuits at 102,400 shots (every scoring line unmodified; only `reaction_depth` is stubbed, see verifier_patch): status, value and phase errors, `eps_plus`, `R`, score, Q, static and executed T; the emitted multiply-call count and the full operation-count deltas; and every pinned bit-writing primitive probed on |1>
scope.not_measured: nothing about the levers' Toffoli counts here -- they remain uncompilable, so they have no score; and the `reaction_depth` diagnostic, which the verifier computes on a 13.9 GB peak and which is not part of the score
